name: blackmessage
description: BLACKMESSAGE desktop (Electron) and Android (Capacitor) app wrapping the website.

scripts.prepare:web: if not exist www mkdir www && copy /Y index.html www\ && copy /Y BLACKMESSAGE.html www\
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:init: npx cap init BlackMessage com.blackmessage.app --web-dir www
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prepare:web && npx cap sync
